shots.subject: player in ALLIGATORS jersey seen from behind, framed through a doorway, looking out to the field
shots.note: strong cinematic opener — silhouetted back-of-jersey through a door frame; ideal cold-open / title-card bed

shots.subject: team walking out toward the field in white ALLIGATORS jerseys (#99, #5, #65) with mascot and coaches
shots.note: great team-walkout / roster reveal shot — jersey names legible, mascot in frame; good early hype beat

shots.subject: players in red practice jerseys running line drills under floodlights
shots.lighting: dusk / blue hour under stadium floodlights
shots.note: moody blue-hour practice — conveys the grind; good B-roll under a VO about dedication

shots.subject: lineman in green jersey and white helmet coiled in a three-point stance at a training cone
shots.note: hero detail shot — low-angle three-point stance, helmet catching floodlight; excellent punch-in / beat-drop candidate

shots.subject: players in teal BRNO jerseys firing off the line in a blocking drill while a coach watches
shots.note: clean daylight line-drill with jersey branding visible; solid athletic B-roll

shots.subject: wide practice field, a player catching/throwing mid-drill with receivers running routes against a graffiti wall
shots.note: wide and a bit dark/distant — usable establishing filler, but subjects are small; lower priority than the tighter shots

shots.subject: live game action — referee in foreground, teal Alligators lined up against a dark-jersey opponent with spectators
shots.note: real game-day context with crowd; ref backside crowds the frame — use as game-establishing wide, not a hero shot

shots.subject: locker-room close-up of BRNO players, one mid-shout and fired up before the game
shots.note: emotional peak — a player screaming hype in the locker room; slightly motion-blurred but that's the energy. Great recruiting close-up

shots.subject: dusk scrimmage — ball carrier in red sprinting with the ball as defenders converge
shots.note: genuine running/pursuit action — the ball is in play and bodies are closing; strong movement beat

shots.subject: dusk run play, ball carrier in red cutting across the field with receivers spread
shots.note: second dusk-scrimmage angle — good motion; a touch soft. Pairs with the 36.0s shot as a running montage

shots.subject: game-day celebration — Alligators players in teal/white uniforms chest-bumping and lifting each other, crowd behind
shots.lighting: bright overcast daylight, Brno hills backdrop
shots.note: celebration payoff — teammates hyping each other after a play; sells the reward of belonging. Prime late-trailer beat

shots.subject: full squad huddled together in teal/white Alligators uniforms with team flags waving
shots.note: peak team-unity shot — whole roster clustered, flags flying, jerseys legible. Best 'join us' hero frame in the clip

shots.subject: the whole team walking toward camera under the goalpost in teal BRNO uniforms, flags flying
shots.note: hero team-walk-to-camera under the uprights — natural closing/hero shot right before the logo card

shots.subject: BRNO ALLIGATORS logo end card on a white background
shots.note: logo-only end card — not action footage; reuse only as a brand bumper / outro plate, skip for the montage body

summary: A polished existing promo for the Brno Alligators American-football club, cut as a mini-hype reel: a brooding through-the-doorway opener, team walk-outs, blue-hour floodlit practice drills, coiled three-point-stance detail shots, real game-day action with a crowd, a raw locker-room hype scream, and a big payoff run of celebration, a flag-waving team huddle, and a confident walk-to-camera under the goalposts before a clean logo end card. The palette swings between bright overcast daylight (games, walk-outs, celebrations) and moody dusk/floodlit blue hour (practices), giving natural grind-vs-glory contrast. Nearly every shot is on-brand, athletic and team-proud — an almost ready-made source of hero and B-roll beats for a recruiting trailer; only the final logo plate is non-footage.
